questions.explanation: After Monday 60% remain. After Tuesday 75% of these remain, i.e. 0.6 × 0.75 = 45%. So total = 270 ÷ 0.45 = 600.

questions.question: In an election between two candidates the winner gets 55% of the votes and wins by 400 votes. The total number of votes is
questions.explanation: The margin is 55% − 45% = 10% of the votes. 10% of the total = 400, so total = 4000.

questions.question: The price of sugar rises by 25%. By what percentage must a family reduce its consumption so that its expenditure stays the same?
questions.explanation: Take the old price as 100 and the new price as 125. Consumption must be scaled by 100/125 = 0.8, a reduction of 20%.

In an election 5,000 people are registered; 20% do not vote and 10% of those who vote have invalid votes. The winner gets 60% of the valid votes. His votes number
questions.explanation: Votes cast = 80% of 5000 = 4000. Valid votes = 90% of 4000 = 3600. Winner = 60% of 3600 = 2160.

questions.question: The length of a rectangle is increased by 10% and its breadth by 20%. The area increases by
questions.explanation: Area multiplier = 1.1 × 1.2 = 1.32, so the area increases by 32%.
